block.guhs.among_taakpaneel.lore: Right-click for a little task. Reward: nothing, Nyeg.
block.guhs.among_noodknop.lore: Calls your guhs together for a meeting. Nothing gets decided.
block.guhs.among_ventilatieluik.lore: Now and then a guh peeks out.
gui.guhs.among.rol.crew.onder: Do your tasks and find the Mika
gui.guhs.among.rol.mika.onder: Push everybody asleep. Don't get seen, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.begin.crew: You are %1$s of the crew of The Chonkfarer. Mikas on board: %2$s. Do your tasks at the panels (they are listed at the top left), right-click a sleeper to report it and press the emergency button in the Cafeteria when you see something odd.
gui.guhs.among.begin.mika: You are %1$s and secretly a Mika (Mikas on board: %2$s). Pillow: push a guh asleep when nobody is looking. Sabotage Map: lights out, Nibble Alarm or doors shut. Right-click a vent to crawl away. And pretend to do tasks!
gui.guhs.among.begin.maat: Your fellow Mika is %s. No pushing each other, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.geduwd.onder: %s pushed you asleep. You simply dream on.
gui.guhs.among.droomguh: You are a dream guh now: you float, go through walls and nobody sees you. Your tasks still count, so finish them! Only other dream guhs hear what you say.
gui.guhs.among.gemeld: %1$s found %2$s asleep! Meeting in the Cafeteria.
gui.guhs.among.knop: %s pressed the emergency button! Meeting in the Cafeteria.
gui.guhs.among.stemmen: Time to vote: pick a guh or skip.
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.gelijk: A tie: nobody was voted out.
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.mika: %1$s flies to the Dorm with a pillow. %1$s was the Mika!
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.geen_mika: %1$s flies to the Dorm with a pillow. %1$s was not the Mika...
gui.guhs.among.weggestemd.jij: You were voted out and are now snug in the Dorm. As a dream guh you can still finish your tasks.
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.onder: Type the code at the Reactor and in Navigation, within 45 seconds
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.half: %1$s typed the code (%2$s). One more panel!
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.klaar: The Nibble Alarm is off: %s typed the last code.
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.deuren: The doors of %s are shut for a moment!
gui.guhs.among.taak.stap: Step done: on to the next panel
gui.guhs.among.einde.mikas_weg: No Mika is awake any more.
gui.guhs.among.einde.overmacht: Too few guhs are still awake.
gui.guhs.among.einde.alarm: The Nibble Alarm ran out: all the nibbles are gone.
gui.guhs.among.einde.gewonnen: You won! That is %1$s more coins (you can still earn %2$s today).
gui.guhs.among.einde.verloren: You lost, but it was cozy all the same. That is %1$s more coins (you can still earn %2$s today).
gui.guhs.among.nee.te_ver: You are too far away for that
gui.guhs.among.nee.mag_niet: You may not do that, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.nee.knop_op: You already used your emergency button
gui.guhs.among.nee.knop_alarm: Turn off the Nibble Alarm first!
gui.guhs.among.nee.luik: Only a Mika fits through there, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.nee.geen_taak: You have nothing to do here right now
gui.guhs.among.nee.taak_mislukt: That was too quick: try again
gui.guhs.among.nee.geen_vergadering: There is no meeting now. Your tasks are at the top left
gui.guhs.among.thuis.noodknop: Emergency meeting! ...nobody comes, everybody is asleep
gui.guhs.among.thuis.ventilatieluik: Peep! One is peeking out, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.thuis.spelitem: This only works on board The Chonkfarer
gui.guhs.among.kaart.luik.uitleg: Click a golden room to crawl there
gui.guhs.among.kaart.kies: Click a room to shut its doors
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.regels.lastig: Hard: 10 participants, 2 Mikas, one and a half times the coins
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.eerst_oefenen: Play the practice round at Captain Guh first
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.eruit: You walked out of the queue
gui.guhs.among.vergadering.droomguh: You are dreaming: you only watch.
gui.guhs.among.vergadering.straks: You may vote in a moment.
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.hallo: Welcome aboard The Chonkfarer, Nyeg! Somewhere among the crew is a Mika who pushes everybody asleep. Do you dare to come along?
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.uitleg: Crew: do your tasks at the panels, report sleepers and vote the Mika out. Mika: push everybody asleep without anybody seeing it. Nobody gets hurt: whoever sleeps dreams on as a dream guh. Winning gives %1$s coins, losing %2$s, and every own task %3$s. At most %4$s coins a day.
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.eerst_oefenen: Welcome to The Chonkfarer, Nyeg! Before you fly along for real we do a practice round. It takes a few minutes and nothing can go wrong.
gui.guhs.among.gids.uitleg: The real game at Captain Guh: do tasks, report sleepers and vote the Mika out. Or be the Mika yourself, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.among_sus: Get voted out three times in Among Guhs
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_ronde.title: Aboard The Chonkfarer
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_ronde.desc: Talk to &bCaptain Guh&r in the Guhpixel lobby and play a whole round of &dAmong Guhs&r. Crew: do your tasks and vote the Mika out. Mika: push everybody asleep without anybody seeing it. Empty places are filled with guhs in space suits. Nobody gets hurt: whoever sleeps simply dreams on.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_crew_winst.des: Win a round as &bcrew&r: finish all tasks together, or vote the Mika out in a meeting. Listen well to what the guhs say: they tell what they really saw. Mostly, Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_mika_winst.des: Win a round as the &cMika&r. Only push when nobody is looking, crawl through the vents, put the lights out and say in the meeting with a straight snout that you were in the Cafeteria.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_lastig.title: Two Mikas on Board
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_lastig.desc: Play a round on &6Hard&r: ten participants, two Mikas and one and a half times the coins. The leader of the queue picks the level.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_pakje.title: Red Is Sus
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_pakje.desc: After your first real round the &dShopkeeper Guh&r sells &dspace suits&r in eight colors and six little hats for your guhs. Buy the &cRed Space Suit&r and put it on a guh. From now on that one always did everything, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_thuis.title: The Chonkfarer at Home
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_thuis.desc: Bring the ship home: buy the &dEmergency Button&r, the &dVent Hatch&r and the &dTask Panel&r from the &dShopkeeper Guh&r. The Emergency Button calls your guhs together for a meeting (nothing gets decided), a guh peeks out of the hatch now and then, and on the panel you do a little task. Reward: nothing, nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.taak.worstjes.bezig: Tie every sausage to its own color
gui.guhs.among.taak.pasje.bezig: Card through the reader: not too fast, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.taak.kruimelbak.bezig: Hold the lever until the tray is empty
gui.guhs.among.taak.pindasaus.bezig: Fill the jerrycan up to the line
gui.guhs.among.taak.sorteren.bezig: Drag every nibble to its own bin
gui.guhs.among.taak.dromen.bezig: Download the dreams. This may take a while...
gui.guhs.among.taak.wegen.bezig: Keep your mouse dead still on the scale
gui.guhs.among.taak.schakelaars.bezig: Set every switch like its little lamp
gui.guhs.among.taak.herstel_licht.bezig: Flip all the switches up: lights on!
gui.guhs.among.taak.herstel_alarm.bezig: Type in the code from the note
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.gevonden.1: %1$s is snoozing in %2$s. That didn't happen by itself, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.0: I pressed the button. Something is off on this ship.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.1: Emergency meeting! I saw something odd.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.2: Sorry to disturb, but this had to happen, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.waar_ik.1: I was just in %2$s doing my task.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.gezien.1: %1$s was walking around in %2$s just now.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.0: I saw %1$s right beside the sleeper in %2$s!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.1: %1$s was standing right next to it in %2$s. Sus, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.2: When I came into %2$s, %1$s was just walking away.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.0: I saw %1$s come out of the vent!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.1: %1$s crawled through the vents. Only a Mika does that!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.2: The vent opened and there was %1$s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.duw.1: %1$s did it! With a pillow! I saw it myself!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.duw.2: %1$s is the Mika. I was right there, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.verdenk.1: %1$s is sus, if you ask me.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.0: I vouch for %1$s, who was with me.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.1: %1$s was with me the whole time. Sweet little chonk.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.2: It can't be %1$s: we were together.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.0: That's not right: I saw %1$s in %2$s just now.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.1: %1$s wasn't there at all. I saw you in %2$s!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.2: %1$s is fibbing. They were in %2$s, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.niks.1: I was nearly asleep. What happened?
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.niks.2: No idea. I was thinking about nibbles.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sus.1: I'll just say it: it's always %1$s.
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.optie.kwijt: I lost my SUS board, Nyeg
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.kwijt: Here, a new board. Extra sus.
gui.guhs.among.taak.thuis: Practice panel for at home. Reward: nothing.
gui.guhs.among.taak.worstjes.fout: That color does not go there, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.taak.pasje.te_vlug: Too fast, Nyeg! Easy does it.
gui.guhs.among.taak.pasje.te_traag: Too slow... even a guh is faster.
gui.guhs.among.taak.pasje.half: Swipe it all the way to the end
gui.guhs.among.taak.pindasaus.gieten: Pour the sauce into the engine, up to the line
gui.guhs.among.taak.pindasaus.gemorst: Spilled! The tank runs empty again, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.taak.dromen.upload: Upload the dreams to the ship's computer
gui.guhs.among.taak.wegen.bewoog: You moved! Stand still again, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.grap.uitleg: A trial round on board The Chonkfarer. There is said to be a Mika. Said to be, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.grap.stap.1: Do your task: the crumb tray in the Cafeteria
gui.guhs.among.grap.stap.2: See what the crew is doing and report a sleeper
gui.guhs.among.grap.stap.3: Join the meeting: who ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.among.grap.stap.4: Find what is snoring in a vent hatch
gui.guhs.among.oefen.titel.onder: Do your task and watch out for the Mika
gui.guhs.among.oefen.begin: Welcome aboard, Nyeg! Everybody is off to do their task. Yours: the crumb tray, right here in the Cafeteria. Right-click the panel (your task is in the top left of your screen).
gui.guhs.among.oefen.taak_klaar: Neat! That is one task of the crew done already. The others must be getting on nicely too. Go and have a look, and right-click a guh when you find one asleep.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.hint.zoeken: Walk into the ship and right-click a sleeping guh
gui.guhs.among.oefen.nee.eerst_taak: Your own task first: the crumb tray in the Cafeteria
gui.guhs.among.oefen.nee.nog_wakker: That one is still awake. For now, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.oefen.nee.stil_luik: Nothing snores here. Try the vent in Electrical
gui.guhs.among.oefen.onderwerp: Meeting: who ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.among.oefen.zeg.1: I was not asleep. I was resting my eyes, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.zeg.3: Me? I was only having a snooze!
gui.guhs.among.oefen.zeg.4: Hang on. Who actually ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.among.oefen.stemmen: Time to vote: who ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.among.oefen.uitslag.rood: Everybody picked %1$s, you too. %1$s ate the nibble, but is no Mika. Nobody gets thrown out.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.uitslag.anders: Everybody picked %1$s, except you. %1$s ate the nibble, but is no Mika. Nobody gets thrown out.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.uitslag.bruin: You picked %2$s. Who is not even at the table... Odd. Nobody gets thrown out.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.uitslag.niemand: Everybody picked %1$s, you skipped. %1$s ate the nibble, but is no Mika. Nobody gets thrown out.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.na_vergadering: Meetings are tiring: everybody is asleep again. But do you hear that? Something is snoring in a vent hatch in %s...
gui.guhs.among.oefen.hint.luik: Find the snoring vent in Electrical (right-click)
gui.guhs.among.oefen.gevonden.chat: %s was the Mika! And fell asleep in the vent before anything happened at all.
gui.guhs.among.oefen.einde: Nobody did anything, so the crew wins. Well done, Nyeg! Want to try it for real? Then come and see me in the lobby.
block.guhs.among_sus_bord.lore: A keepsake of the practice round. Red is sus.
gui.guhs.among.sus_bord.3: Who ate the last nibble? Sus.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.eis: Play a round of Among Guhs first
gui.guhs.among.winkel.pakje: A space suit with an air tank for your guh. Cosmetic only, honestly.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.pakje.rood: A red space suit with an air tank. Whoever wears it is always sus, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.hoedje.plantje: A little plant for on your guh. No watering needed.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.hoedje.ei: A fried egg. Do not eat it: it is a hat.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.hoedje.wc_rol: A toilet roll. Always handy, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.hoedje.kaaspunt: A wedge of cheese. It smells a bit.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.hoedje.knabbel: A giant nibble. Hands off: it is a hat.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.among_noodknop: Calls your guhs together for a meeting in which nothing gets decided.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.among_ventilatielu: For in the floor. Now and then a guh peeks out.
gui.guhs.among.winkel.among_taakpaneel: A real task panel for at home. Reward: nothing.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.vergadering.begin: Emergency meeting! %s guhs are on their way.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.vergadering.bezig: There is a meeting going on already, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.thuis.vergadering.net_gew: The guhs are still tired from the last meeting
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.0: Item %s: who finished the nibbles? Nobody knows.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.1: Item %s: the nap schedule. Proposal: more naps.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.2: Item %s: the pillows. Too few. Always too few.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.3: Item %s: why are we here? No idea, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.4: Item %s: the minutes of last time. They were eaten.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.5: Item %s: any other business. Can the window be shut? There is a draught.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.6: Item %s: a new chair guh. Nobody wants to.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.agenda.7: Item %s: chonking during working hours. Unanimously in favor.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.besluit.0: Decision: nothing. The meeting is closed, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.besluit.1: Decision: we will have another meeting about this later.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.besluit.2: Decision: a nap first. Meeting closed.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.besluit.4: Decision: there will be a committee. It will do nothing either.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.besluit.rood: Decision: %s is sus. That is because of the red suit, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.thuis.taak_klaar: Task 1 of 1: done! Reward: nothing, Nyeg
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_klaar.title: The Practice Round
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_klaar.desc: Talk to &bCaptain Guh&r in the lobby of &dGuhpixel&r and fly a practice round on &dThe Chonkfarer&r. Do your task, see what the rest of the crew is up to and find the Mika. There is said to be one on board, Nyeg. The first time you get 100 coins and a keepsake, and after that you may join the real game.
